# Vendored browser libraries

Copied unmodified from the career repo's vendored builds (cdnjs `.min` files), so the
rendered digest page loads nothing from a CDN.

| Library | Version | File | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| marked | 12.0.2 | `marked/marked.min.js` | MIT |
| DOMPurify | 3.1.6 | `dompurify/purify.min.js` | Apache-2.0 or MPL-2.0 |
